end.summary:
Yash practised the levels of organisation: cell, tissue, organ, organ system and organism.
Yash gave human examples including muscle tissue, heart, stomach and circulatory system.
Yash explained that an organ system is a group of organs working together.
Yash practised examples for humans and plants; the final teach-back was not yet complete.
end.parentNote: Yash practised ordering the levels of organisation and identifying examples at each level. Yash used the method of linking each level to its size and function, such as the heart pumping blood and working with blood vessels. Yash initially mixed up an organ with an organ system, but corrected this later by explaining that the heart is one organ within the circulatory system. At home, Yash can make a five-step ladder and add one human and one plant example beside each level.
